clips.title: The story
paras: Inside Deathknell's chapel, Novice Elreth guides the newly risen Forsaken. She sends them against the mindless Scourge near the graves and helps them face the plague's sorrowful aftermath.

Novice Elreth guides newly risen undead inside the desecrated chapel at Deathknell. They struggle to understand their horrific awakening, while the Forsaken must organize quickly to secure their territory. Elreth sends them south to gather paws from wolves and wings from bats. She also points them toward Lordaeron's tragic aftermath, including the sorrow of her friend Marla Fipps, whom her husband Samuel killed after joining the mindless Scourge.
